verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Government of India has not announced any scheme to provide free mobile recharges. Messages claiming this are fake and are often part of phishing scams designed to defraud people.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Numerous TIER_1 fact-checking organizations and the Indian government's Press Information Bureau (PIB) have repeatedly debunked this claim. Evidence shows that messages promoting a free 3-month recharge from the Prime Minister are part of recurring phishing scams. These scams use fake links to defraud users. No such official scheme exists.
